newsitem.title: UK: UK's SFA expels two former Dillon Reed employees.
newsitem.headline: UK's SFA expels two former Dillon Reed employees.

text.p: Two former employees of Dillon Read Securities Ltd have been barred from working in the securities industry here after the Securities and Futures Authority (SFA) watchdog scrapped them from its registers.

The SFA said it expelled Clive Harris from its registers of directors, managers, finance officers and compliance officers after deceiving Dillon Read Securities into paying 5,500 pounds ($8,960) of a personal bill.
Harris, who had Dillon Read partly pay for an extension to his house, was also fined 3,500 pounds and required to pay 2,750 pounds towards SFA costs.
Harris worked as a director of finance and administration and as a compliance officer at Dillon Read. He resigned after his misconduct was discovered in September last year.

The SFA said in a statement it also expelled Peter Paton from its register of managers and required him to pay 2,000 pounds for SFA costs after he admitted having misapproriated about 4,600 pounds from Dillon Read.
Paton resigned from his job as financial controller in September 1996 before his misconduct was discovered early this year.
Both Paton and Harris have repaid Dillon Read in full.
Both cases, which were unconnected, were concluded through settlement, the SFA said.
